messages:
alice.k: Quick sync — ran into a customer case where mixed-dim arrays (some 768, some 1024) are getting accepted by the proxy, routed to shard A, and then failing downstream with a 413 / dim-mismatch. Is the proxy supposed to validate dims or just forward?
ben_r: Ideally proxy should validate and reject early with a 4xx so we don't eat runtime cycles. We never shipped a strict-dim contract for the embeddings route though.
carol_dx: for UX we could show a console hint saying 'mixed dims detected — see docs' before they submit. lightweight and avoids unexpected failures for novice users.
dan_product: Agree on early validation, but we need a migration path. Tons of customers rely on implicit pad/truncate behavior in old clients. If proxy starts rejecting suddenly we’ll break them.
alice.k: Proposal: proxy performs opt-in strict validation via a header `X-Embed-Dim-Mode: permissive|strict|warn`. Default remains permissive for rollout. If `strict` -> reject mismatches with 400 + helpful error. If `warn` -> forward but add telemetry and response header `X-Embed-Dim-Warning: mixed-dims`. Thoughts?
ben_r: That sounds reasonable. Implementation notes: proxy can check shapes cheaply by inspecting first item dims and verifying others. For large batches we should early-sample N items (configurable) to avoid O(n) penalty on huge payloads. Also add a fast path for scalar / single-embedding payloads.
carol_dx: For console, we can expose the header toggle on route settings under "Embeddings > Payload handling" with a tooltip. Add a live validation indicator in the request inspector showing detected dims and a red/yellow/green state. Green = all same, Yellow = mixed (warn mode), Red = rejected (strict).
telemetry-bot: New event: embed.dim.mixed_detected {count:int, sample_dims:["int"]} emitted when mode=warn or permissive with sample size>1.
dan_product: We need to define quota implications. If proxy samples only a subset, billing telemetry must still count tokens correctly. Also doc the exact semantics so customers can rely on behavior.
alice.k: Right — add two telemetry metrics: `embed.batch.sample_size` and `embed.dim.mode` in traces. For billing and cost SLOs we'll keep existing token counting untouched — the validation is only to gate routing.
ben_r: Implementation plan: add validation middleware in the proxy (3 files), add config knobs (env + per-route override), add sampling param default 8. Toggle default `permissive`. Rollout: internal canary -> beta tenants (opt-in) -> gradual default switch to `warn` -> then maybe `strict` after 6 weeks if no major breakages.
carol_dx: Console mocks ready. I'll drop screenshots in the doc next. UX question: when warn-mode finds mixed dims, should we surface a one-click "auto-split" suggestion that opens SDK snippet?
dan_product: Yes. Show a small code snippet that uses our client-side splitter util and highlight cost/latency tradeoffs. That fix path improves success rates without server-side changes.
alice.k: Edgecases: empty arrays, null embeddings, and single-stream (chunked) uploads. We'll treat empty/null as a 400. For chunked/batched streams the proxy will validate after finalization — so warn might be delayed. Add a clear note in docs.
ben_r: I'll add unit tests for sample sampling, for payload sizes up to 10k embeddings. Also add a circuit-breaker: if validation adds >1% latency at P95 on a node, we auto-disable sampling on that node and emit alert.
carol_dx: For observability, we want a dashboard tile: "Embeds: dim consistency" showing rate of mixed-dims, top clients, and rollout state. Add filter by route/model id.
alice.k: Ok action items: ben -> PR for proxy middleware and tests, include sampling param and headers (due EOD Wed). carol -> console mocks and telemetry dashboard mock (due Thu). dan -> draft rollout comms and migration doc (due Fri). telemetry-bot -> emit the new events after PR merged.
ben_r: One more internal API question: should the proxy return a machine-readable error code like `EMBED_DIM_MISMATCH` in JSON body? I vote yes to make retries/clients easier.
dan_product: Yes include `code`, `message`, `docs_url`, and `example_fix` fields in the 400.
alice.k: perfect. I'll file the umbrella ticket with these specs and link the console mock and telemetry schema. Thanks all :thumbsup:
telemetry-bot: note: logged action: created ticket INF-1248 "Embed dim validation + console hint" assigned to alice.k, ben_r, carol_dx, dan_product"
